title: The WP Ultimate CSV Importer WordPress plugin before 9.2, WP Ultimate CSV Importer Pro WordPress plugin before 9.0.7…
description: The WP Ultimate CSV Importer and WP Ultimate CSV Importer Pro WordPress plugins before versions 9.2 and 9.0.7 respectively, expose exported post files via a publicly accessible location with predictable filenames. This allows unauthenticated attackers to download content and custom fields of any exported post, including non-public content.
